notes.title: Patch 0.6.0.1
notes.content: This patch fixes the update menu's bugs, It also updates the passive drop UI, and adds two new movement abilities! Experience will now speed up towards you, and will not be blocked by your abilities. Frag grenades are now able to be converted. I went a bit back and forth on this as I felt like not being able to convert them added a challenge, but honestly being able to convert them is just so much more fun.

notes.title: Patch 0.6.0.0
notes.content: This patch makes sure you get three different ability upgrades each time to choose from, no longer will upgrades overlap. I've also added an icon for the player upgrades. I've fixed the upgrades for the aim skills as well on PC.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.1.1
notes.content: Quick micropatch that increases the amount of cooldown reduced by the upgrade, as well as reduces the likelihood of it appearing.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.1.0
notes.content:
This patch adds a bunch of new abilities!

[list]
[*] Allegiance
[*] Exodus
[*] Flesh and Blood
[*] Hellfire
[*] Holy Hand Grenade
[*] Reflector
[*] Temptation
[/list]

I'll leave what they do up to you to find out!
I've also shuffled around a few upgrade costs and added cooldown as a reward to all active abilities.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.0.4
notes.content:
I've added a new enemy type to the game, the fragger. The fragger shoots a grenade that explodes into many little bullets. The grenade will also push away other bullets. Players cannot convert the grenade by default, but I plan on adding another passive ability that will let you convert grenades. 

In addition to this, I have fixed a bug that caused the newly added songs to repeat. The opacity of the level up bar was lowered as well, which should make it easier to dodge bullets that are coming at you from the bottom of the screen. I plan on overhauling the levelling bar soon, so expect some more changes there.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.0.3
notes.content: A small update that changes the swap control UI to be a bit more intuitive. Will also add stick support for these menus in the future. Fixes positional audio and aiming of Holy Light & Holy Water.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.0.2
notes.content: This update adds a settings button to the main menu, allowing you to change the master volume of the game. It also adds a quit button so you don't have to alt+f4 out of the game any longer. In addition to this, I've added 24 new tracks to the game, so there'll be a bunch of new tunes to groove out to.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.0.1
notes.content: The game has been updated to fix the updates screen as well as some bugs with mouse-aim skills. The new skill menu will now also highlight the selected skill.
